meta.study: Anchored hash chains for agent audit logs
meta.hash: SHA-256 with domain separator, canonical JSON

attacks.edit_value: change one claim string, do not recompute any hash
attacks.delete_middle: remove one middle entry, leave remaining entries untouched
attacks.insert_forged: insert a forged entry with a correctly computed self-hash
attacks.reorder: swap two adjacent entries, keeping their contents intact
attacks.truncate_tail: drop the last three entries, leaving a self-consistent prefix
attacks.reseal_chain: change one claim, then recompute the entire chain from scratch

meta.data_note: Synthetic logs generated deterministically; not real deployment data.
